config.description: Periodic stock-take batches. Each row drills down to the line snapshot, the variance review and the reconciliation actions. Filter by status, type, date range and, for partial counts, location.

config._note: MASTER archetype (native CnDetailPage). A cycle count is a periodic stock-take SESSION (REQ-ICC-006/REQ-ICC-010): a header carrying scope, dates, and the aggregate expected/counted/variance totals, with a lifecycle (draft -> submitted -> counting -> posted -> reconciled -> cancelled). The counted stock lines (InventoryCycleCountLine, one per sku/location pair per REQ-ICC-003) are surfaced as a relatedCollection keyed on FK countId=@object.countId (see _relatedCollectionsNote), so a reviewer walks from the session header to every counted line and its flagged variance/reason code. lifecycleActions on for the submit/begin-counting/post/reconcile/cancel state machine per REQ-ICC-006. An audit-trail sidebar tab records who counted and reconciled per REQ-ICC-007. No documents tab - counts are entered in-app, not source documents; no comms tabs - this is an accounting event, not a conversation.
config._relatedCollectionsNote: KEY: the prop is `relatedCollections`; a `relatedLists` block is not a prop on any Cn page component, lands in $attrs and renders nothing while every gate stays green. TOKEN: `@object.countId`, NOT `@objectId` — WRITER-PROVEN. OCA\Shillinq\Service\CycleCountService::snapshotScope() sets `$countId = $count['countId']` from the parent's FLAT payload field (pattern ^CC-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{5}$) and writes it onto every line as `'countId' => $countId`; the service's own reader findLinesForCount() filters lines with `['countId' => $countId]`. A UUID filter would match zero rows. NOTE: the old block's `detailRoute` pointed at CycleCountDetail — this page itself — which would navigate a LINE click to a cycle-count detail keyed by the line's id. There is no InventoryCycleCountLineDetail page, so `rowRoute` is deliberately OMITTED rather than pointed at the wrong page.
config.description: Lifecycle controls: submit to snapshot the scope, begin counting, post for variance review, reconcile to emit StockMoves, and cancel. Variance lines needing investigation are highlighted, and the reason-code list is drawn from the active set in InventoryVarianceReason.

The reason codes offered when a counted quantity differs from the recorded one. Bookkeepers can retire a code without affecting counts that already use it, and warehouse managers and bookkeepers can add new ones per administration.

config._note_rowRoute: `detailRoute` is inert; the implicit fallback matches by register+schema and this index is bound to InventoryCycleCountLine. The description below promises a row-click drilldown that did nothing without `rowRoute`.
config.description: Aggregated view of every flagged variance line. Grouping by reasonCode produces the count-by-reason rollup, and clicking a row drills back to the originating count and its adjustment StockMove.
